findings.title: Raw SQL Syntax Error Leakage on /api/vulnerable/users
findings.evidence:
Database error signature matched: /you have an error in your sql syntax/i
Response snippet: {"error":"Internal Database Error","sql_message":"You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near ''' at line 1","query":"SELECT id, username, email FROM users WHER
reproduction_steps: Observe HTTP 500 with unhandled SQL error syntax disclosure
findings.impact: Critical. Attackers can extract complete database contents, bypass access controls, or tamper with business data.
findings.remediation: Replace string concatenation with parameterized prepared statements (e.g. db.query(sql, [param])).
findings.cwe_ref: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

findings.title: Boolean Query Response Disparity on /api/vulnerable/users
findings.evidence: True payload returned 95 bytes; False payload returned 95 bytes.
reproduction_steps: Submit 1' AND '1'='2 -> returns empty set or error
findings.impact: Enables blind SQL inference of database records character-by-character.
findings.remediation: Use strict type casting and prepared statements.

findings.title: Query Parameters Safely Bound on /api/secure/users
findings.evidence: Status: 200. No SQL parse signatures encountered.

findings.title: Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection on /api/vulnerable/login
findings.evidence: Bypass payload granted authenticated session without valid password: {"success":true,"message":"Authentication successful","user":{"id":1,"username":"alice","role":"user"}}
reproduction_steps: Submit POST to /api/vulnerable/login with username: "admin' OR '1'='1' -- "
findings.impact: Critical. Attackers can log in as administrator or arbitrary users without knowing their password.
findings.remediation: Validate credentials using parameterized SELECT WHERE username = ? and compare hashed password via bcrypt.

findings.title: Authentication Input Properly Handled on /api/secure/login
findings.evidence: Rejected with status 401: {"success":false,"message":"Invalid username or password"}
reproduction_steps: Submitted SQL injection payload to login endpoint
findings.remediation: Maintain secure parameterization and password hashing.
